full_judgment: 9. On perusal of the prosecution papers it appears that allegations against the petitioner is that she was a Trustee of Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Charitable Trust formed by herself. It further appears that after collecting fund from different sources they purchased 0.42 acre of land from plot No.218 appertaining to RS Khatian No.82 and corresponding to SA, khatian No. 86 of Mouza Kakrail from Dr Yeasmin and Ayrin Jobaida Khan, through their constituted Power of Attorney Suraiya Khan in the name of said Trust vide deed No. 404/2005 dated 19-1-2005. The deed No. 4041/2005 dated 19-1-2005 (Sutrapur) SR office) shows that the petitioner as Trustee paid consideration of Taka 6,52,07000 through pay order No. 8471567 issued from the Sonali Bank Prime Minister Office Branch. From the charge sheet it transpires that the Investigating Officer found that a sum of Taka 1,24,93,000 had been also paid through pay order No. 8471568 dated 19-1-2005 to said Suraiya Khan, the Power of Attorney of the land owners. The Investigating officer in his report stated that this said amount had been paid as excess amount, which was not consideration as it appears from the recital in the deed itself which is an offence punishable under section 5 (2) of the Prevention of the Corruption Act, 1947. Mr Hossain submits that amount was paid as consideration of the land purchased in the name of Shaheed President Ziaur Rahman Trust. Since the recital of the deed does not support submission of Mr Hossain, we are of the view that the said amount of Taka 1,24,93,000 had been paid for giving pecuniary advantage to executants of the deed or their power of attorney or not is purely question of fact which can only be ascertained after recording of evidence.
